ProgramUnit.Name: FIND_DATA_OLD
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE FIND_DATA_OLD IS
 rv_bool boolean;
 CURSOR C1 IS
 SELECT unit_id FROM units
 WHERE unit_id = nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id, unit_id)
 AND nvl(chapter_id,:GLOBAL.chapter_id) = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND batch_id = :ctrl_blk_1.batch_id;
BEGIN
 go_block('unit_details');
 message('Working...',no_acknowledge);
 IF :ctrl_blk_1.batch_id is not null THEN
 FOR u_rec in C1 
 LOOP
 rv_bool := FIND_DETAILS(u_rec.unit_id);
 END LOOP;
 ELSE
 rv_bool := FIND_DETAILS(:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id);
 END IF; 
 clear_message;
 IF :system.cursor_record = 1 AND
 :unit_details.unit_id is null 
 THEN
 IF :ctrl_blk_1.batch_id is not null AND
 :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id is null 
 THEN
 first_record;
 :unit_details.bat := 'Y';
 :ctrl_blk_1.batch_only := 'Y';
 :ctrl_blk_1.unit_prompt := 'Batch ID';
 :unit_details.unit_id := :ctrl_blk_1.batch_id;
 ELSE
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 check_package_failure;
 show_error('2331');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 first_record;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: FIND_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION FIND_DETAILS(p_unit_id in varchar2, set_flag in varchar2 := 'Y')
RETURN boolean IS
 temp_x varchar2(1);
 procedure set_unit(fld in varchar2) is
 begin
 IF :unit_details.unit_id is null and set_flag = 'Y' THEN
 :unit_details.unit_id := p_unit_id;
 END IF;
 IF set_flag = 'Y' THEN
 copy('Y','UNIT_DETAILS.'|| fld);
 END IF;
 end;
BEGIN
 BEGIN
 SELECT 'x' INTO temp_x 
 FROM units 
 WHERE unit_id = p_unit_id
 AND nvl(chapter_id,:GLOBAL.chapter_id) = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND rownum = 1;
 IF set_flag != 'Y' THEN
 return TRUE;
 END IF;
 set_unit('UNITS');
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 null;
 WHEN others THEN 
 handle_error;
 END;
 BEGIN
 SELECT 'x' INTO temp_x 
 FROM unit_interdictions 
 WHERE unit_id = p_unit_id
 AND nvl(chapter_id,:GLOBAL.chapter_id) = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND rownum = 1;
 IF set_flag != 'Y' THEN
 return TRUE;
 END IF;
 set_unit('UI');
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 null;
 WHEN others THEN 
 handle_error;
 END;
 BEGIN
 SELECT 'x' INTO temp_x 
 FROM unit_attributes 
 WHERE unit_id = p_unit_id
 AND nvl(chapter_id,:GLOBAL.chapter_id) = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND rownum = 1;
 IF set_flag != 'Y' THEN
 return TRUE;
 END IF;
 set_unit('UA');
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 null;
 WHEN others THEN 
 handle_error;
 END;
 BEGIN
 SELECT 'x' INTO temp_x 
 FROM holding_tests 
 WHERE unit_id = p_unit_id
 AND nvl(test_chapter_id,:GLOBAL.chapter_id) = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND rownum = 1;
 IF set_flag != 'Y' THEN
 return TRUE;
 END IF;
 set_unit('HT');
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 null;
 WHEN others THEN 
 handle_error;
 END;
 BEGIN
 SELECT 'x' INTO temp_x 
 FROM unit_test_base 
 WHERE unit_id = p_unit_id
 AND nvl(test_chapter_id,:GLOBAL.chapter_id) = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND rownum = 1;
 IF set_flag != 'Y' THEN
 return TRUE;
 END IF;
 set_unit('UTB');
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 null;
 WHEN others THEN 
 handle_error;
 END;
 BEGIN
 SELECT 'x' INTO temp_x 
 FROM utrs 
 WHERE unit_id = p_unit_id
 AND nvl(test_chapter_id,:GLOBAL.chapter_id) = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND rownum = 1;
 IF set_flag != 'Y' THEN
 return TRUE;
 END IF;
 set_unit('UTR');
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 null;
 WHEN others THEN 
 handle_error;
 END;
 BEGIN
 SELECT 'x' INTO temp_x 
 FROM rgt_skip_samples 
 WHERE unit_id = p_unit_id
 AND nvl(chapter_id,:GLOBAL.chapter_id) = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND rownum = 1;
 IF set_flag != 'Y' THEN
 return TRUE;
 END IF;
 set_unit('SKP');
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 null;
 WHEN others THEN 
 handle_error;
 END;
 BEGIN
 SELECT 'x' INTO temp_x 
 FROM rgt_tubes 
 WHERE unit_id = p_unit_id
 AND nvl(chapter_id,:GLOBAL.chapter_id) = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND rownum = 1;
 IF set_flag != 'Y' THEN
 return TRUE;
 END IF;
 set_unit('TUB');
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 null;
 WHEN others THEN 
 handle_error;
 END;
 IF :ctrl_blk_1.batch_id is not null 
 and :UNIT_DETAILS.unit_id is not null
 and :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id is null
 THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT 'x' INTO temp_x 
 FROM batch_inputs
 WHERE batch_id = :ctrl_blk_1.batch_id
 AND contract_id = :ctrl_blk_1.contract_id
 AND nvl(chapter_id,:GLOBAL.chapter_id) = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND rownum = 1;
 :unit_details.BAT := 'Y';
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 null;
 WHEN others THEN 
 handle_error;
 END;
 END IF;
 IF set_flag != 'Y' THEN
 return FALSE;
 END IF;
 IF :unit_details.unit_id is not null THEN
 :test_count := nvl(:test_count ,0) + 1;
 next_record;
 END IF;
 RETURN TRUE;
END;

 /* -- Commented by Kishore on 09/05/2012. SCR 19480. Code moved to SMRSUPR1 report.
 go_block('unit_details');
 first_record;
 
 loop
 Delete FROM units 
 WHERE unit_id = :unit_details.unit_id

 Delete FROM unit_interdictions 
 WHERE unit_id = :unit_details.unit_id

 IF :ctrl_blk_1.batch_id is not null

 AND nvl(chapter_id,:GLOBAL.chapter_id) = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 END IF;
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE';

ProgramUnit.Name: PRINT_REPORT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE PRINT_REPORT 
IS
 p_name VARCHAR2(30) := 'SMRSUPR1';
 temp_parm_id VARCHAR2(30) ; -- := 'SM_' || to_char(SYSDATE,'YYMMDDHH24MISS'); SCR 18938
 temp_COUNT NUMBER;
 ttype VARCHAR2(5) := NULL;
 t_mode VARCHAR2(15) := 'COMPRESSED';

 v_local_date DATE := SYSDATE; -- SCR 18938
BEGIN
 -- Calculate local time (SCR 18938)
 IF is_timezone_enabled 
 THEN
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, SYSDATE, v_local_date);
 END IF;

 temp_parm_id := 'SM_' || to_char(v_local_date,'YYMMDDHH24MISS');

 -- End SCR 18938 

 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := 10;

 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*) 
 INTO temp_count
 FROM rpt_parm
 WHERE appl_id = 'DON' AND 
 user_name = :banner.user_id AND 
 report_name = p_name AND 
 parm_id = temp_parm_id
 ;
 IF temp_count = 0 
 THEN
 BEGIN
 INSERT INTO rpt_parm
 (
 appl_id
 , user_name
 , report_name
 , parm_id
 , parm_date
 , submit_date
 , report_status
 )
 VALUES
 (
 'DON'
 , :banner.user_id
 , p_name
 , temp_parm_id
 , SYSDATE
 , SYSDATE
 , 'E'
 );
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS 
 THEN
 handle_error;
 END;
 ELSE
 BEGIN
 UPDATE rpt_parm 
 SET submit_date = SYSDATE
 , report_status = 'E'
 WHERE appl_id = 'DON' AND 
 user_name = :banner.user_id AND 
 report_name = p_name AND 
 parm_id = temp_parm_id
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS 
 THEN
 handle_error;
 END;
 BEGIN
 DELETE FROM rpt_parm_SELECT
 WHERE appl_id = 'DON' AND 
 user_name = :banner.user_id AND 
 report_name = p_name AND 
 parm_id = temp_parm_id
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS 
 THEN
 handle_error;
 END;
 END IF;
 POST;
 FIRST_RECORD;

 LOOP
 BEGIN
 INSERT INTO rpt_parm_select
 (
 appl_id
 , user_name
 , report_name
 , parm_id
 , parm_no
 , parm_SELECT
 , parm_code
 )
 VALUES
 (
 'DON'
 , :banner.user_id
 , p_name
 , temp_parm_id
 , 1
 --, :unit_details.unit_id -- Commented by Kishore on 09/02/2015. SCR 20202
 , :units.unit_id -- Added by Kishore on 09/02/2015. SCR 20202
 , 'UNIT'
 )
 ;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS 
 THEN
 handle_error;
 END;
 EXIT WHEN :SYSTEM.LAST_RECORD = 'TRUE';
 NEXT_RECORD;
 END LOOP;
 COMMIT;

 REPORT_GENERATE
 (
 LOWER(p_name)
 , temp_parm_id
 )
 ;
 END;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := 0;
END;

PROCEDURE REPORT_GENERATE
 (
 pl_rep_name IN VARCHAR2
 , pl_parm_id IN VARCHAR2
 ) 
IS
 parameters VARCHAR2(150) := NULL;
 command VARCHAR2(200) := NULL;
 temp_return NUMBER;
 filename VARCHAR2(1000);

*/

 );

 ------------

 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_SERVER,l_svr_name);
 SET_REPORT_OBJECT_PROPERTY(report_id,REPORT_OTHER, 'paramform=no');

 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id, 'P_PARM_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER, pl_parm_id) ;
 --ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'NO_OF_COPIES',TEXT_PARAMETER,'1');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id, 'P_CHAPTER_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER, NVL(:global.chapter_id, 'WAD'));
 --ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'PRINT_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,NULL);

 --ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'DELETE_AFTER_PRINT_FLAG',TEXT_PARAMETER,:rpt_parm.delete_after_print_flag);

ProgramUnit.Name: FIND_UNITS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
-- Added by Kishore on 09/02/2015. SCR 20202
procedure find_units(p_unit_id in varchar2) is

 cursor c1 is 
 select upper(table_name) table_name, upper(column_name) column_name
 from appl_rep_columns
 where application = :banner.prog_name;

 v_cursorid integer;
 v_cursorid1 integer; -- Added by Kishore on 09/16/2015. IM 115
 v_rowselect integer;
 v_rowselect1 integer; -- Added by Kishore on 09/16/2015. IM 115
 v_temp number;
 v_temp1 number := 0; -- Added by Kishore on 09/16/2015. IM 115
 v_selectstmt varchar2(500);
 v_selectstmt1 varchar2(500); -- Added by Kishore on 09/16/2015. IM 115
 v_check number;
 table_not_exist exception;
 PRAGMA EXCEPTION_INIT(TABLE_NOT_EXIST, -00942);
 temp_x varchar2(1);
begin
 v_check := 0;
 go_block('unit_details');
 first_record;
 
 for c1_rec in c1 loop
 v_cursorid := dbms_sql.open_cursor;
 v_cursorid1 := dbms_sql.open_cursor; -- Added by Kishore on 09/16/2015. IM 115
 
 v_selectstmt := ' select count(*) ' ||
 ' from ' || c1_rec.table_name ||
 ' where ' || c1_rec.column_name || ' = ' || 
 in_quotes(p_unit_id) ||
 ' and rownum = 1 ';
 
 -- Parse the query;
 dbms_sql.parse(v_cursorid, v_selectstmt, 2);

 --Define the output variables
 dbms_sql.define_column(v_cursorid, 1, v_temp);

 -- Execute the statement
 v_rowselect := dbms_sql.execute(v_cursorid);
 
 -- Added by Kishore on 09/16/2015. IM 115
 if upper(c1_rec.table_name) in ('RGT_TUBES', 'RGT_DUP_TUBES') then
 v_selectstmt1 := ' select count(*) ' ||
 ' from ' || c1_rec.table_name ||
 ' where cbc_unit_id = ' || 
 in_quotes(p_unit_id) ||
 ' and rownum = 1 ';
 else
 v_selectstmt1 := ' select count(*) from dual where 1 = 2 ';
 end if;
 
 dbms_sql.parse(v_cursorid1, v_selectstmt1, 2);
 dbms_sql.define_column(v_cursorid1, 1, v_temp1);
 v_rowselect1 := dbms_sql.execute(v_cursorid1);
 -- End of change for IM 115

 -- This is a fetch loop
 loop
 -- Fetch the rows into the buffer, and also check for the exit
 -- condition from the loop
 /* -- Commented by Kishore on 09/16/2015. IM 115
 if dbms_sql.fetch_rows(v_cursorid) = 0 then
 exit;
 end if;
 -- End of commented section for IM 115 */
 
 -- Added by Kishore on 09/16/2015. IM 115
 if dbms_sql.fetch_rows(v_cursorid1) = 0 or dbms_sql.fetch_rows(v_cursorid) = 0 then
 exit;
 end if;
 -- End of change for IM 115

 -- Retrieve the rows from the buffer into PL/SQL variables
 dbms_sql.column_value(v_cursorid, 1, v_temp);
 dbms_sql.column_value(v_cursorid1, 1, v_temp1); -- Added by Kishore on 09/16/2015. IM 115

 --if v_temp > 0 then -- Commented by Kishore on 09/16/2015. IM 115
 if v_temp > 0 or v_temp1 > 0 then -- Added by Kishore on 09/16/2015. IM 115
 :unit_details.unit_id := p_unit_id;
 :unit_details.table_name := c1_rec.table_name;
 :unit_details.units := 'Y';
 v_check := v_check + 1;
 else
 :unit_details.table_name := c1_rec.table_name;
 :unit_details.units := '';
 end if;
 end loop;

 -- Close the cursor
 dbms_sql.close_cursor(v_cursorid);
 dbms_sql.close_cursor(v_cursorid1); -- Added by Kishore on 09/16/2015. IM 115
 next_record;
 end loop;

 first_record;
 go_block('units');
 --:units_yes := to_char(v_check);
 :ctrl_blk_1.test_count := v_check;
exception
 when table_not_exist then
 message('Msg: Cannot access database tables'); pause;
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 when others then
 dbms_sql.close_cursor(v_cursorid);
 dbms_sql.close_cursor(v_cursorid1); -- Added by Kishore on 09/16/2015. IM 115
 message(sqlerrm); pause;
 handle_error; 
 check_package_failure;
end;
-- End of change for SCR 20202
